ns2:course.label: Photography II
ns2:course.description: Uses digital process to express content with emphasis on the development of a personal aesthetic. See Class Schedule for average cost; student must furnish camera. Prerequisite: ARTD 260.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Photography major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For Art majors only. Class Materials Fee of $15 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
